cohort: 39 pregnant women with SARS-CoV-2 infection and preterm birth compared with a control group of 39 women COVID-19 negative with preterm birth
finding: Microscopic examination of placentas from women with SARS-CoV-2 infection and preterm birth revealed a higher incidence of placental infarction, decidual arteriopathy, intervillous thrombi, perivillous fibrin deposits, inflammatory infiltrate, and chorangiosis compared to the control group.
